items.title: Molson Coors Q3 Earnings Miss Estimates as Cost Inflation Weighs
items.summary: TAP's Q3 earnings and sales miss estimates as weak beer demand and rising costs squeeze margins, prompting a cut to its 2026 earnings and sales outlook.

items.title: CELH Q3 Earnings Top Estimates as Alani Nu Drives Revenue Growth
items.summary: Celsius Holdings beats Q3 earnings and revenue estimates as Alani Nu and international growth lift sales despite CELSIUS brand weakness and margin pressures.

items.title: Can Celsius Holdings' Brand Restructuring Drive Long-Term Growth?
items.summary: CELH's brand-led restructuring aims to sharpen execution, boost efficiency and drive long-term growth as its energy drink brands show mixed trends.

items.title: Primo Brands' Q3 Earnings Beat on Premium Water Growth
items.summary: PRMB beats Q3 2026 earnings and sales estimates as premium water revenues surge 24.3% free cash flow improves and 2026 sales growth outlook nears 3%.

items.title: US Foods Q3 Earnings Surpass Estimates, Sales Increase Y/Y
items.summary: USFD's Q3 earnings beat estimates on stronger margins and case volumes, but sales fall short as it narrowed the fiscal 2026 growth outlook.

items.title: INGR Q3 Earnings Miss Estimates as Higher Costs Hurt Margins
items.summary: Ingredion's Q3 earnings lag estimates as higher manufacturing costs and softer demand squeeze margins, prompting a cut to its 2026 earnings outlook.

items.title: MNST Q3 Earnings Meet Estimates, Sales Beat on Global Growth
items.summary: Monster Beverage's Q3 sales beat estimates on robust international demand and energy-drink growth, while earnings met expectations amid rising cost pressures.

items.title: General Mills Soars 5% With Packaged Food as Kraft Heinz Calls 2027 Price Hikes “Likely”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysGeneral Mills shares rose 5% today with Campbell’s, Conagra and Smucker after Kraft Heinz said price increases are likely in 2027. Investors are betting packaged-food makers can pass rising costs on to shoppers.
